module.name: Live Observability Namespace
module.description: Cloud-agnostic primitive: create and label a Kubernetes namespace for BNK live observability (Loki + collector). Default namespace is 'llm-egress', matching the Forge AI Gateway observability defaults in PR #393.

optional.name: observability_namespace
optional.description: Name of the Kubernetes namespace to create for live observability components (Loki, Fluent Bit). Default matches Forge AI Gateway observability setting observability_namespace in PR #393.

optional.name: poc_label
optional.description: Value for the bnk-forge/poc label added to the namespace. Useful for grouping and cleanup in multi-tenant clusters.

key_outputs.name: observability_namespace
key_outputs.description: Name of the created namespace. Wired into downstream loki, collector, and readiness modules.

key_outputs.name: namespace_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once the namespace exists and is Active. Downstream modules depend on this.
